Lunch.notes: Venue not chosen yet — open for shortlisted options.

Check in at Anyin.notes: Check in and rest an hour — you have just jumped to 2,400 m.

Dayan Old Town.notes: Easy flat wander through the quieter canal lanes north of Sifang Square.

Sifang Square.notes: The old town’s central square — people-watching and lane-wandering.

Mu Mansion.notes: The Naxi chieftain’s residence — admired from outside today.

Dinner.notes: Venue not chosen yet — open for shortlisted options.

Breakfast.notes: Hotel breakfast; open the hotel card for details.

Depart for the gorge.notes: Bus (~2 h) or a private driver / small-group tour (~¥400–600) to combine.

Qiaotou gateway.notes: The gorge gateway town, ~2 h from Lijiang.

Tiger Leaping Gorge.notes: One of the world’s deepest gorges — violent rapids between towering peaks.

Middle Gorge descent.notes: Descend the cliff path (or the Sky Ladder) to the river.

Glacier Park cable car.notes: Go straight here first for clear morning views.

Jade Dragon summit.notes: 4,680 m glacier platform — walk slowly; an oxygen canister is cheap insurance.

Impression Lijiang.notes: Zhang Yimou’s open-air show at 3,100 m with the mountain as backdrop.

Blue Moon Valley.notes: Milky turquoise terraced pools — walk the full lakeside path (60–90 min).

Old Town massage.notes: Optional alternative to the courtyard dinner.

Baisha Village.notes: Original Naxi capital with farm lanes and Jade Dragon rising behind it.

Baisha Murals.notes: Ming-era murals blending Naxi, Tibetan and Han Buddhist styles.

Baisha embroidery.notes: Naxi silk-thread embroidery institute in Baisha.

Shuhe Old Town.notes: Dayan’s calmer sibling — cobbled lanes and canals. Lunch here.

Tea Horse Road Museum.notes: Small museum on the caravan trade through Shuhe.

Lashi Lake wetland.notes: Highland wetland — boat or horse ride.

Black Dragon Pool.hours: Best light late afternoon; calmest water at opening
Black Dragon Pool.notes: Classic pagoda-and-snow-mountain reflection — best light late afternoon.

Lion Hill sunset.notes: Climb for sunset rooftops-and-mountain views now that you are acclimatized.

Last Dayan loop.notes: Choose Black Dragon Pool at opening or a quiet final Old Town loop.

Fly from LJG.notes: TV9812 departs 18:20 — be here by 16:20. ~28 km south of the old town.
